gate_notes.hooked-design-copy: Hero states a position and names the mechanism. It fails the portability test in the right direction: 'AI doesn't buy the media' only makes sense to someone who buys media.
gate_notes.prose-specificity: Every signal chip names a real metric direction and a real source. No chip says 'data' or 'insights'.
gate_notes.voice-preservation: The brief's own phrases are kept verbatim where they carry the idea: 'shortens the time between signal and decision', 'what changed / what should I do next', 'STRONG SIGNAL / NEEDS MORE DATA / LOSING MOMENTUM', 'Recommendation first, decision second, execution third' (compressed to the decision rule line).
gate_notes.dash-crutch: No em or en dashes in any visible slot.
gate_notes.literal_labels_kept_literal: Platform names, chain steps, decision labels and node numbers stay literal. Only the hero, the zone heads and the closer carry hooks.
